text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — Crescendo Insurance just paused procurement. CISO wants: full network topology, explicit data access rights, SOC2 evidence, and a commitment to customer-isolated tenancy. They said if we don’t provide clear answers by EOD they’ll move to a competitor. CIO meeting at 5pm PT. Need legal + engineering input now.
jamie_se: On it. Short answer: Dedicated gives isolation but not VPC peering. Private (VPC/on-prem) supports peering. We can do IP allowlists and customer-managed NAT on Dedicated as an interim.
alex_sales: Can Dedicated be framed as "isolated tenancy" in sales docs? Customer cares about egress controls and third-party access.
srinivas_pm: We can phrase Dedicated as "isolated compute pools with strict network controls" but cannot claim VPC peering. Timeline: spin up Dedicated pilot in ~10 business days if infra team prioritized. Private onboarding 4–6 weeks after contract + infra provisioning.
maria_legal: I need their DPA + exact list of systems/data they consider "access." Ask CISO for answers to these items: 1) data types (PII, PHI, logs), 2) who needs access (support/devs), 3) retention/exports. I can draft limited redlines for our standard DPA by EOD.
ben_support: I'll create support ticket INC-2026-045 and attach the runbook for Dedicated onboarding + an ops checklist. Also adding a pricing delta calc for single-tenant add-on.
olivia_cto: Exec-level move: offer a 30-day Dedicated pilot with strict contract language + option to convert to Private within 60 days post-signature. Include 3 months of premium support credits to bridge trust. Suggest a 1:1 note from our CEO to their CIO if they push.
alex_sales: Draft of 1:1 email to CIO — pulling from olivia_cto suggestion. Please quick-review: 
```
Subject: Proposal to unblock Crescendo procurement
Hi [Name],
Thanks for the candid feedback. We propose a 30-day Dedicated pilot (isolated GPU pool, IP allowlist, support credit) to validate performance and controls. If the pilot meets your security bar, we commit to a Private deployment timeline within 60 days and will execute a DPA amendment capturing access controls.
Can we confirm the CISO questions below before the 5pm call?
- Which data classes will be processed?
- Which internal/external principals need access?
- Any mandatory encryption/KMS requirements?
Regards,
Alex (Redwood)
```
maria_legal: Looks fine. Add sentence: "This pilot does not alter our standard data processing obligations — details to be captured in DPA amendment."
ben_support: Added INC ticket and pricing sheet to the ticket. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-045
deploybot: Calendar invite created: Crescendo CISO sync — 2026-04-05 17:00 PT.
alex_sales: Update after call: CISO pushed back on support/dev access — wants zero-console access and strict audit logs. They've agreed to the pilot if we can guarantee role-based access + KMS controls. Legal is reviewing our redlines. I'll update ticket. :thumbsup:
olivia_cto: Good. Ops action: document RBAC mapping and KMS flow, include audit export path. Who owns the KMS integration doc?
jamie_se: I'll pair with infra to draft KMS integration and RBAC notes. Target: initial draft by EOD tomorrow.
srinivas_pm: I'll add a canary rollout plan and SLA language to the proposal.
alex_sales: Customer tentative acceptance of pilot subject to legal sign-off. Leaving this thread open; will post final decision here. Thanks everyone. :pray:
